description: This file is a shell script used for testing corner cases and various scenarios related to the 'git archive' command, including handling empty trees, different archive formats (tar, zip), large files, and long paths.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and registers its removal after the test finishes.

methods.name: check_dir
methods.description: Checks that a directory contains exactly the expected set of paths.

methods.name: build_tree
methods.description: Generates a git tree with files of various lengths for testing long path handling.
